free_text: Despite the prior positive biopsy, the high-risk PI-RADS 4 finding and the significant PSA velocity of 2.7 ng/mL/yr warrant further tissue assessment per the EAU guideline. The combination of high-risk imaging and rising PSA velocity, despite the known diagnosis, indicates a need for further tissue assessment to guide management.
